errors.text: The proposed stepwise precipitation treatment does not reconstruct the target 6 GPa, 1473 K, 2 h HPHT treatment.
The hypothesis changes the material from lamellar Al0.7CoCrFeNi FCC/B2 eutectic alloy to a W-based refractory alloy with different phases and embrittlement physics.
The proposed precipitate-mediated mechanism omits the target hierarchical FCC/B2 structure, coherent interfaces, interphase dislocation transfer, and convergence of phase-resolved GND densities.

The predicted values and relevant metrics differ substantially from the target result: greater than 2 GPa yield strength and about 15% elongation versus approximately 1150 MPa fracture strength and 36% uniform elongation.
